hypothesis: Zero-shot released sim-only FNO on Fold A is a viable fine-tune start if, after persist-first-4, the better of the two preregistered normalizers beats persistence on TKE and MVPE.
comparator: Fold A persistence and E013 persist-first-4 CNO; E003 is a clean CNO negative reference only

train_sim.source: computed over released train_sim windows with E005 WindowGeometry

controls: No fine-tuning and no sim_real_ft FNO
k=4 and the E006 interval stay frozen
Both normalizers are reported; selection of 'better' uses TKE+MVPE only after both are computed
promotion: evidence only; do not package. A pass only authorizes a later FNO fine-tune experiment
limitations: Zero-shot sim-to-real is not the same as an E005-recipe fine-tune.
Official real-train stats are a domain-stat swap, not the stats used in sim pretraining.
fp16 packing is officially discouraged; this preflight uses the fp32 sim_fno checkpoint.
